description: Add first-class support for jackielii/skhd.zig as a selectable variant alongside the original koekeishiya/skhd. Includes auto-detection (PATH, launchd, Homebrew, .app bundle), settings UI for variant choice, variant-aware service management (skhd.zig uses SMAppService and skhd --start-service / --stop-service / --restart-service rather than brew services and a separate plist label com.jackielii.skhd), variant-aware config path lookup (XDG support), variant-aware log tailer (~/Library/Logs/skhd.log), parser extensions for skhd.zig directives (.alias, .define, .path, .device, .remap, mouse1-mouse5, backtick, @group, mode-with-command) rendered read-only, status badge showing the active variant, install guidance with Homebrew tap (brew install jackielii/tap/skhd-zig), one-click 'Install Service' / 'Uninstall Service' buttons, and a migration wizard that stops original skhd, prompts for brew install, registers and starts skhd.zig.
